notes.title: Introducing The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest!
notes.content:
From Programancer, the developer of Prison City and Dumpy & Bumpy, comes a brand new game: 
The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/17d018457265d1b21b491d3bc5fa6d3c4c360eed.gif

You’re supposed to be the hero, but your spotlight was taken away!
Rival Stan Helsing defeated Dracula first, now Simon Quest must embark on a journey of retribution to raise the Count from the dead piece-by-piece, slay him, and obtain the glory he deserves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/e177be3fc6432b1c6b3f3194f7a5233e4265b8bd.png
Go on a perilous journey through the world of Transylvania. 
Explore dark mansions, discover minigames, and collect different parts of Dracula to raise him from the dead…then kill him!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/d85a1818fad2a0834abc5f7aea3a7be4f6fe0d19.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/20a7583f60581d1a50e3ce60fd060b1742ee5b37.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/e48d165cfd87ad404ccaff90661f2a4cdfe3fe46.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/55d3a3740022272187c588f027fe58f67610f138.png
Create different equipment chains and customize your experience with a host of adjustable settings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/871811dac65663c3e87756e519a388e3126f411a.png
Wanna take a break from your journey? Enjoy a fine platter of minigames that include: Memory, Fishing, Crabbin Races, Crane Game, and even some Launch Surfing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/3d2b93c44d1d20359440f2ddcf96f1420540c657.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/6e9372e099e0caf4053fb3c662a2a050f4c8a213.png
We’re excited to announce this new project in development with Programancer!

AND, if you’re itching to get your hands on playing a preview of The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest (TASQ), YOU CAN at MAGFest 2024 at the National Harbor from Jan. 18 - Jan. 21!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29892260/4ae75f2a4248160f07d34ebfc00650448d5cb1d6.png
Look for the Retroware booths in the MIDDLE of the MIVS hall! We’ll also be featuring Toxic Crusaders right next to our TASQ booth, so be sure to stop by both!

We can’t wait to have players take their first dive into The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest (TASQ)! Look forward to even more!

WISHLIST NOW!

notes.title: MEME MACHINE 8/3/18 STEAM UPDATE
notes.content:
Redone/retuned difficulty, each character now has an Easy/Normal/Speedy difficulty based on what tower they are in.
Added an AI Versus mode to the main menu that lets you select your opponent and their difficulty from unlocked characters, so it's easier to climb the leaderboards. Now finishing an AI Versus match will show you your score and time relative to the rest of the Steam players.
Miscellaneous polish and bug fixes all over the place
